a.lede: At a Brooklyn midterm party five days before Election Day, every conversation, from a council member’s fireside chat to a debate about the Democratic Party, kept circling back to AI and data centers.
a.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn

b.lede: Several counties put data center issues on the ballot during the midterm elections, with most Americans voting against data center development in their county.
b.title: AI data centers comprehensively defeated at US midterm elections — 45 measures put on the ballot as Americans overwhelmingly vote against developments
